name: subgraph_composition
description: 명시적 worker/reviewer 노드 → barrier 동기화 → 조건부 라우팅 → 복합 에이전트
natural_spec: Build a strict Core graph (1) with three worker branches, (2) a reviewer branch, (3) a router that decides based on worker outputs whether to invoke the reviewer or return directly, and (4) a barrier synchronizing the workers before the router.
